Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
In our last playing session, some questions arose:

1. May reaction cards be played on ANOTHER methusalah's minions?

For example: may I wake a Vamp of my prey's prey so that he may avoid
being ousted?
or: may I give a Vamp of my prey's prey intercept with my
intercept cards (for similar purposes?)

This may be a great deal of boons lurking in the shadows, but also a
measure of attack: If you play an intercept card which costs blood...

2. If Legacy of Caine is played on a minion, may this steal blood action
be combined with hunting effects (for example: steal 2 blood with
Aaron's Feeding Razor)?

Card Text:
"Put this card on a vampire with a capacity above 6 controlled by
another Methuselah. When the vampire with this card hunts, he or she
steals 1 blood from another vampire as a (D) action instead of
performing the usual hunting action."
(May be useful to copy Francois Villon's ability)

--

Michael Beer, Dortmund, Germany, ICQ 1175389

Messages.Author: Rubbduck
Messages.Body:
> 1. May reaction cards be played on ANOTHER methusalah's minions?
>

> For example: may I wake a Vamp of my prey's prey so that he may avoid
> being ousted?
> or: may I give a Vamp of my prey's prey intercept with my
> intercept cards (for similar purposes?)
>
> This may be a great deal of boons lurking in the shadows, but also a
> measure of attack: If you play an intercept card which costs blood...

As reaction cards are essentially minion cards, and used by a special
minion, you can't do so. Another metuselah's minions can't play cards
from your hand.

> 2. If Legacy of Caine is played on a minion, may this steal blood > action
> be combined with hunting effects (for example: steal 2 blood with
> Aaron's Feeding Razor)?
>
> Card Text:
> "Put this card on a vampire with a capacity above 6 controlled by
> another Methuselah. When the vampire with this card hunts, he or she
> steals 1 blood from another vampire as a (D) action instead of
> performing the usual hunting action."
> (May be useful to copy Francois Villon's ability)

As the card says "instead of (...) the usual hunting action", this is
not a hunt anymore, but a direct "steal" attack on another vampire, so
you can't use effects which increase his hunt.

Rubbduck

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Michael Beer wrote:
>
> In our last playing session, some questions arose:
>

> 1. May reaction cards be played on ANOTHER methusalah's minions?
>
> For example: may I wake a Vamp of my prey's prey so that he may avoid
> being ousted?
> or: may I give a Vamp of my prey's prey intercept with my
> intercept cards (for similar purposes?)

No.

> 2. If Legacy of Caine is played on a minion, may this steal blood action
> be combined with hunting effects (for example: steal 2 blood with
> Aaron's Feeding Razor)?

No, but the Razor does give him one extra blood for the successful hunt.
(i.e., he steals one and gains one from the blood bank). (*)

Other hunting effects work similarly. (*)
